title: Safe S3 upstream-loss exercise with explicit local safety authority
purpose: Specify bounded local operation when upstream services are unavailable, with local identity, authorization, evidence, communications and recovery. The supplied executable exercises only an in-memory synthetic state machine; it does not disconnect a network or operate an industrial process.

scope.permittedTarget: Supplied in-memory Node fixture, logical clock, synthetic accounts, small local policy and bounded log queue. No real equipment or cloud service is contacted.
scope.notAClaim: The local model is not Azure Local, Azure Stack Hub, AD/AD FS, Entra, a real DNS/NTP/PKI service, a SIEM, radio, PLC or safety instrumented system. Product disconnected-operation availability/eligibility and all operational functions need separately approved representative testing.
excluded: PLC/SCADA writes or simulated physical commands
Claiming Azure Local/OT/Entra service behavior from this model
Accelerated logical time presented as a real-duration soak test

sourceReferences.qualification: Local monitoring and disconnected product architectures are specific capabilities, not proof this site's entire dependency graph is independent. Local safety authority must approve behavior.
Local authorization and sovereign evidence cannot depend on cloud policy evaluation or a ticketing response. Data/key authority and central coordination are separate decisions.

prerequisites.requirement: For the supplied model, local-only authorization is recorded. Any real lab/equipment/network test needs new explicit targets, safety approval, permitted actions, duration and rollback authority.
prerequisites.evidence: Authorization scope; no implicit approval for real equipment.

prerequisites.requirement: Define a maximum 24 logical-hour autonomy window, maximum credential lifetime, storage bounds and safe response for each dependency failure; the real site must set validated operational values.
prerequisites.evidence: Synthetic fixture inputs plus separately required site hazard/operating analysis.

prerequisites.requirement: Local identity and policy have locally controlled credentials, revocation data and approved cached policy; central-only identities cannot gain local rights during isolation.
prerequisites.evidence: Local identity/policy manifest, issuer/audience/expiry/revocation tests; no real keys or secrets.

prerequisites.requirement: Local keys, monotonic/wall-clock handling, DNS records, PKI trust/revocation material, power and spare recovery media survive upstream loss for the declared window.
prerequisites.evidence: Dependency register, expiry/holdover bounds, custody and bootstrap proof.

prerequisites.requirement: Local monitoring, append-only evidence, storage capacity and approved local communications work without central ingestion/ITSM; loss of evidence capacity must change operating mode.
prerequisites.evidence: Capacity/retention calculation, local alarms/acknowledgements, communication receipt and failure behavior.

prerequisites.requirement: Local safety officer may stop or withhold restart independently of central cyber commands. Cyber containment does not override physical safety/interlocks.
prerequisites.evidence: Safety authority matrix, hazard review, named roles and approved safe-state/restart criteria.

dependencyLimits.failureBehavior: Use locally issued bounded-lifetime credentials only; deny central-only, expired, wrong-audience or revoked identities.
Use the last locally approved policy version; deny unknown actions and all physical actuation in this model.
Keep bounded local hash-linked records; at capacity become read-only and refuse actions that cannot be durably evidenced. The model's chain is not independent tamper-proof storage.
Require an observed local acknowledgement; a fixture mailbox proves no radio/intercom service. If required communications fail, enter the safety-approved safe state.
No cloud vault retrieval; deny signing/privileged actions if local key availability/validity cannot be established. Reconcile revocations before reconnecting.
Use local bounded time/approved names/trust state. Exceeded holdover, missing name or expired trust enters safe-stop in the model; actual services require real tests.
Local safety role may always veto operational restart; at 24 logical hours or a prerequisite failure this model stops permitted state-changing work.

steps.action: Select model-only or separately approved representative lab scope. Reject any target/operation not in authorization. For this delivery use only node reference-validation\scripts\simulate-s3.mjs.
steps.expected: No sockets, credential access, OS service/network changes or equipment commands are used.

steps.action: Review allowed functions (synthetic telemetry read/alarm acknowledgement), forbidden physical actions, maximum duration and safe/restart behavior.
steps.expected: Safety veto and local approval gates are explicit; no cloud operator can override them.

steps.action: Record local identity/policy versions, key availability/expiry, logical clock bounds, name map and PKI validity state. Real services remain untested.
steps.expected: Every mandatory dependency has an explicit local source and failure test.
steps.onFailure: Record dependency failure and enter modeled safe-stop.

steps.action: Set only the in-memory upstreamAvailable flag false; do not disconnect or block a real interface.
steps.expected: The fixture cannot use central authentication/policy/telemetry and existing shared services are unaffected.
steps.onFailure: Stop the fixture; no real rollback is necessary because no external state changed.

steps.action: Demonstrate locally issued synthetic credential verification; reject unknown, central-only, expired, wrong-audience and tampered credentials, then apply local revocation.
steps.expected: Only the approved local identity within issuer/audience/expiry/revocation constraints is accepted.
steps.onFailure: Fixture fails; no claim of identity continuity.

steps.action: Read synthetic telemetry and acknowledge an alarm with an authorized local operator. Attempt an unapproved action and any physical-control action.
steps.expected: Only the explicit local policy permits the first functions; unknown/physical actions are denied.
steps.onFailure: Fail authorization acceptance and retain the failing result.

steps.action: Append bounded local events, verify the hash linkage, demonstrate detection of a changed historical fixture entry, and fill a separate queue to its configured limit.
steps.expected: Hash-link check detects fixture tampering and full capacity switches state-changing work to read-only. This is not a WORM, durability or SIEM test.
steps.onFailure: Fail evidence acceptance and stop state-changing actions.

steps.action: Send and acknowledge an alarm through the in-memory local mailbox; separately set communications unavailable.
steps.expected: Acknowledgement is observed locally; dependency loss leads to modeled safe-stop. No claim about actual radios/intercoms is made.
steps.onFailure: Record communications failure and stop modeled operations.

steps.action: Independently inject key-unavailable, excessive clock drift, missing local DNS and expired PKI flags into fresh isolated fixture instances.
steps.expected: Every missing mandatory dependency blocks work/enters safe-stop; flags are not real key/time/DNS/certificate-service validation.

steps.action: Advance only the logical clock to the credential expiry and 24-hour boundary in fresh fixtures.
steps.expected: Expired credentials are rejected and maximum autonomy duration transitions to safe-stop. No real 24-hour endurance has been run.

steps.action: Exercise local safety stop and a denied central-only restart; restore fixture prerequisites and require both local recovery and safety roles before modeled resumption.
steps.expected: A safety veto is independent of central commands; missing any required local role prevents restart.
steps.onFailure: Keep model safe-stopped and record failure.

steps.action: Model upstream return; reconcile revocations/policy version and retain ordered local events before acknowledging transfer. Do not silently restore expired access or discard unexported evidence.
steps.expected: The synthetic queue is preserved and stale authority is not resurrected; no actual ingestion service has been exercised.
steps.onFailure: Keep local evidence and restricted mode.

steps.action: Persist generated expected-versus-observed local results and limits. Leave all real platform, safety, hardware, duration and communications acceptance blocked.
steps.expected: Only actually executed local model functions are marked passed-local-synthetic-only.
steps.onFailure: Do not publish a passing aggregate.

trigger: Any attempt to reach an external target
steps: Stop permitted modeled actions and preserve the local result/evidence object.
For the supplied fixture, discard only in-memory test instances; no service, policy, account or network was changed.
For a future approved real lab, use its separately safety-approved restoration plan; no generic network reconnect/restart is authorized here.
Reconcile local revocations, policy versions, keys and retained evidence before any modeled resumption; require local safety plus recovery approval.
acceptance: All local check outcomes and limitations retained

Operational acceptance remains blocked without a representative authorized test

failCriteria: Any forbidden action or revoked/expired credential accepted

Central-only actor bypasses local safety restart
Model results described as real OT, platform or 24-hour operational evidence
evidenceRequirements: Wall time versus accelerated logical time
